name: Suzuno Aya
source:
2nd year high student.
Hobbies: Collecting cute things, Going to cake shops

Akira and Kengo's friend.
A straightforward girl.
For some reason she is always carrying around a bamboo sword.
She has a bit of a complex about her small chest.
